messages:
raj: Heads-up — ACME Ops scheduled a security review call tomorrow 11:00 PST. They sent a questionnaire focused on RBAC, audit logging, KMS integration, and incident response.
melissa: I'll own RBAC answers. Can someone paste current role matrix link? :point_up:
sophie: role matrix: https://redwood.internal/docs/rbac/matrix (internal)
tyler: I'll handle KMS integration questions. We use customer-managed AWS KMS with grants + envelope encryption. Quick sample key policy I usually paste:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Access"},"Action":"kms:Encrypt","Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```
raj: @tyler add note about support for GCP CMEK and Azure Key Vault in private deployments.
melissa: RBAC Qs: we have role-based service identities, admin/ops/dev/readonly. We can add customer-specific roles via organizations API. Example PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/842
security-bot: New vuln triage alert: CVE-2026-0451 affects dependency xyz — status: in progress, mitigation: upgrade to 3.2.1, ETA deploy tomorrow.
raj: Add that to the questionnaire under 'vuln management' — mention patching SLA (72h critical), exploit mitigation, and customer notifications.
oncall: FYI we have an incident runbook snippet ready; paste below for call if asked:
```
1) Triage -> Severity assign.
2) Isolate traffic via routing policy.
3) Spin up fallback model variant.
4) Notify customers via status.redwood.com and reach out to account leads.
```
melissa: For audit logging: we stream token-level events to customer-owned S3 for Private, and to RedLogs (encrypted) for Hosted. Query sample:
```
SELECT * FROM audit_events WHERE customer_id='acme' AND action='model.generate' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;
```
tyler: Action items before call:
- melissa: paste RBAC examples + PR
- tyler: finalize KMS key policy and list supported KMS providers
- sophie: confirm audit log retention options
- raj: prep slides and escalation contacts
sophie: Got it. I'll update the questionnaire doc and ping when done.
melissa: I'll join the call and bring RBAC diagrams. :white_check_mark:
raj: Thanks team. I'll set up the call invite and include the questionnaire LINK.
